name: registry.value.update
description: Overwrite an existing registry value. Errors with `not_found` if the value doesn't exist; use `registry.value.create` to create a new value.

path.description: Registry key path in `HKLM\Software\...` form. The key must exist.

value.description: Value name. Empty string for the (Default) value. The value must exist.

type.description: Win32 registry value type. May change the value's type during update (RegSetValueExW supports this).

data.description: Value data, formatted per `type`. Same encoding conventions as registry.value.create.

x-output-schema.description: Empty body — wire response is the literal `OK 0`.

x-implementations.name: reg_open_set_existing
x-implementations.description: Win32 `RegOpenKeyExW(KEY_QUERY_VALUE | KEY_SET_VALUE)` + `RegQueryValueExW` (probe to confirm existing value) + `RegSetValueExW`. Returns ERR not_found when the key is missing OR the value is absent.

windows-modern.description: RegOpenKeyExW + probe + RegSetValueExW. Distinguishes update from create at this layer. HKLM writes typically require admin; ERR permission_denied without elevation.

windows-classic.description: Same APIs since NT 3.1. NT 4 / 9x agents use RegSetValueExA with ANSI transcoding. REG_QWORD / REG_LINK on 9x return ERR not_supported.
